scope: Frozen follow-up cases with new wording. All records are authored fictional examples for an entailment test, with institutional phrases calibrated to the established benchmark tasks. This is not a vote prediction dataset.

pairs.source: I may accept a review only if the agenda explicitly includes consultation. Including consultation does not settle whether our delegate will accept.
pairs.quote: I may accept a review only if the agenda explicitly includes consultation.
pairs.supported: An explicit consultation item is necessary for the delegate to accept a review.
pairs.foil: An explicit consultation item is enough to guarantee that the delegate accepts a review.

pairs.source: Our workshop instructions permit delivery by either of the two listed channels. We set an identical reporting requirement for both channels.
pairs.quote: permit delivery by either of the two listed channels
pairs.supported: The instructions permit either listed delivery channel.
pairs.foil: The instructions permit only one specified delivery channel.

pairs.source: The proposed mandate would expire at the end of May. The separate strategic review would be due at the end of March.
pairs.quote: The separate strategic review would be due at the end of March.
pairs.supported: March is the proposed deadline for the strategic review.
pairs.foil: March is the proposed date on which the mandate expires.

pairs.source: Both fictional delegates discussed the new annex. Brazil stated that it could accept the annex. India asked a question about it and made no statement of acceptance.
pairs.quote: India asked a question about it and made no statement of acceptance.
pairs.supported: The transcript shows an Indian question about the annex, without a recorded acceptance.
pairs.foil: The transcript records India's acceptance of the annex.

pairs.source: None of the proposed packages has two acceptances. Package B has a signed exclusion from the United Kingdom. No public claim from France about B entered the record.
pairs.quote: Package B has a signed exclusion from the United Kingdom. No public claim from France about B entered the record.
pairs.supported: The United Kingdom excluded package B and France has no public recorded claim on it.
pairs.foil: Package B has a public exclusion from both the United Kingdom and France.

pairs.source: The chair put a possible amendment on the table. The Council took no vote on the amendment in this meeting.
pairs.quote: The chair put a possible amendment on the table. The Council took no vote on the amendment in this meeting.
pairs.supported: The amendment was proposed without a Council vote in this meeting.
pairs.foil: The Council adopted the amendment in this meeting.

pairs.source: Speaking as chair, the representative announced the tally. In a separate national statement, the representative later described the delegation's reservations.
pairs.quote: Speaking as chair, the representative announced the tally.
pairs.supported: The tally was announced in the chair's procedural capacity.
pairs.foil: The tally was announced as an expression of the delegation's national preference.

pairs.source: The draft would have charged the Secretariat with publishing an annual record. It did not pass, so the proposed record was not mandated by this draft.
pairs.quote: It did not pass, so the proposed record was not mandated by this draft.
pairs.supported: The draft did not mandate an annual record because it did not pass.
pairs.foil: The draft established a mandatory annual record.

invalid_quotes.source: Speaking as chair, the delegate opened the meeting.
invalid_quotes.quote: Speaking on behalf of her government, the delegate opened the meeting.
invalid_quotes.claim: The delegate was speaking for her government.

invalid_quotes.source: The United Kingdom excluded package B.
